description: This file contains system information utilities for hardware components such as block devices, network devices, NUMA nodes, CPU topology, caches, and huge pages, primarily used for system introspection in Kubernetes environments.

methods.name: GetBlockDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about block devices present on the system, filtering out non-disk and hidden devices, and gathering device size and scheduler info.

methods.name: GetNetworkDevices
methods.description: Gathers information about network interfaces, excluding certain virtual or system interfaces, including their MAC address, MTU, and speed.

methods.name: GetHugePagesInfo
methods.description: Returns info about pre-allocated huge pages in the system, including number of pages and page size.

methods.name: GetNodesInfo
methods.description: Provides NUMA node topology, including cores, memory, cache, huge pages, and inter-node distances.

methods.name: GetCacheInfo
methods.description: Returns cache details for a given CPU thread, including size, level, and type.

methods.name: GetSystemUUID
methods.description: Retrieves the system's UUID via sysfs.

methods.name: GetSocketFromCPU
methods.description: Finds the socket ID for a given CPU based on topology.

methods.name: GetOnlineCPUs
methods.description: Returns a list of all online CPU thread IDs based on topology.
